name: Major Project Part II
description: This project-based course provides students with the opportunity to undertake in-depth research or development in robotics, applying concepts from mechanics, control, perception, planning, and machine learning. Students work on a real-world problem, design a robotic system or algorithmic solution, and validate it through simulation and experimentation.
